The '''Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History''' was a recurring event that concerned itself with research efforts into the [[Sentientologist|anthropology]] and history of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] cultures. In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], the 412th Proceedings were hosted by the [[Brentaal Academy]].<ref name="EGTW" />

During that event, [[Vilnau Teupt]] delivered the keynote address "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]," in which they recounted the history of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture, from its conquest of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]; through the Mandalorian clans' involvement in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Return (Mandalorian)|Return]], and the [[Mandalorian Excision]]; and up until the events of the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Mandalorian Civil War]] and the role the Mandalorians played in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History were introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
